evaluation.normalization: Unicode casefold; remove punctuation/symbols; split on whitespace
evaluation.matching: maximum one-to-one exact token and line bbox support; repeated tokens retain separate occurrences
evaluation.ignore: exclude ignored GT; predictions on ignored regions remain FP
evaluation.empty: normalized-empty GT lines contribute zero words and are reported; empty predictions count as one FP
evaluation.limitation: line-supported recovery proxy; no GT word boxes and no word-position validation; not official polygon Hmean

scientific_choices.choice: User-requested CTW word recovery extension. The paper does not evaluate CTW1500 or define this protocol. See CWR-001 in docs/PAPER_AMBIGUITIES.md.
Reuse frozen qualified YOLO/PARSeq TEST proposals, readings, Unicode normalization, joint confidence and same-reading NMS. GT only enters evaluation.
Whitespace tokens after normalization are word occurrences. Preserve repeated tokens, count empty GT lines explicitly, and use maximum one-to-one matching.
Reuse the earlier line-fragment diagnostic spatial rule: at least half of the prediction box lies in the GT line axis bbox. This is a relaxed line support proxy, not a word IoU test.
Report the same prefilter controls at fixed joint 0.60; do not tune or replace inference parameters from TEST word scores. Cache analysis assumes frozen OCR; actual new batches require qualification.
Exact GT positions for words inside lines, duplicated detections of repeated words, official word/polygon evaluation and ignored-region prediction treatment are not established by this proxy.

Audit the complete frozen 95-threshold grid at fixed joint confidence. Report the analytic output-preserving bound separately from TEST-selected maximum F1. Do not deploy a TEST-selected threshold. See CWA-001.
